ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio (approximately 0.05:0.95); the visible fluke surface is dominated by low-intensity, dark pixels with minimal high-intensity variance.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark, low-intensity contiguous surface across both lobes; absence of macro-level mottling or high-contrast geometric blobs on the central ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body relative to the posterior edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude saw-tooth serrations (peaks and valleys) distributed continuously along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex mathematical curve fitted to the posterior boundary of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, light-colored textured clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to dense pixel concentrations at the lateral margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) creating an irregular, high-contrast texture at the lateral tips; a secondary small notch is visible on the inner edge of the right lobe adjacent to the primary median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a significantly thicker, more protrusive cluster of high-intensity textured pixels compared to the left tip.
